title: docs(qa): integration-system checklist ledger edits from the 18.2.0 release sweep
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GG6dtKvMNZ8xxrTDR9DFQC)_
Fixes #25844
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Wave anchor: #25807 (the 18.2.0 release test sweep; it remains open).

## What changed

One file, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`: 13 items revised, each with its `revision` bumped once and one `history` row that cites the run record its lines came from (QA runs #25812, #25815, #25817, all at `6679644a`). Every line was re-read on `main` first (`9753d163`, then merged up to `f6c61932`; the file has not changed on `main` since 2026-10-22, before the card was filed). Edits were made as in-place text replacements, so the file's hand-kept formatting is untouched outside the changed values.

The pattern across most lines is the same: an `automated.ref` or a clause's `verify` named a pin as covering more than the pin asserts, or left out a pin that does exist. Those texts now say which clause each pin scores, at which layer, and what still needs a live reading (RUNNER rule 6).

## The 26 lines

| # | Item · clause | Record | Disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · steps[2] | #25812 | Applied. Read on main: `DatasourceSchema`'s superRefine adds an issue at path `external` when `schemaMode` is not `managed` and the block is absent. The step now says so and says that 400 is not a credential refusal. |
| 2 | connector-auth-kind-application · a2 | #25815 | Applied. The missing-ref case asserts only `/credentialRef 'MISSING' did not resolve/` on an in-process kernel. The verify now scores the served boot output and names the pin as evidence only. |
| 3 | connector-auth-kind-application · a3/n1 | #25815 | Applied. `connector-provider.test.ts` added to the ref for the #7990 half. No pin refuses oauth2 on `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema`, and the ref and verify now say that. |
| 4 | connector-declarative-boot · n1 | #25815 | Applied. The build rejections are three. `provider: 'no_such_provider'` builds clean (an open snake_case string) and is acceptance[4]'s boot error, so steps[5] now boots it. |
| 5 | connector-declarative-boot · ref | #25815 | No edit. The run found the ref accurate. |
| 6 | connector-descriptor-audit · a2 | #25815 | Applied. `auditDeclaredConnectors` runs on reload and on `kernel:ready`. The pin drives `kernel:ready` only, and the verify and ref now say that. |
| 7 | connector-descriptor-audit · a1(c)/n1 | #25815 | Applied. No case feeds a provider-bound instance. The verify and ref say so. |
| 8 | connector-stdio-default-deny · ref | #25815 | No edit. The run found the ref accurate. |
| 9 | datasource-admin-lifecycle · a8 | #25815 | Applied. `datasource-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` added to the ref for the ledger half. The 404 half is named as stubbed-service evidence. |
| 10 | email-template-render · a5 | #25815 | Applied. `email-template-overlay-survives-boot.dogfood.test.ts` added to the ref for the redeploy-survival half. |
| 11 | email-template-render · a3 | #25815 | Applied. `email-template-two-locales-survive-boot.dogfood.test.ts` added to the ref for the en-US rung. |
| 12 | email-template-render · ref | #25815 | Applied. The ref is narrowed per clause, and acceptance[1], [2], [4], [6] and [7] are named as unpinned. |
| 13 | external-schema-drift-gate · a4/a6 | #25815 | Applied. Both clauses score from their pins. The armed-timer log line is now a separate boot leg, not a pass condition. |
| 14 | external-schema-drift-gate · n3 | #25815 | Applied, with a correction. The fail-default case does assert only `toBeInstanceOf`. But `renderDiffMessage`'s text is pinned as a pure function in `packages/spec/src/shared/external-errors.test.ts`. The ref records both facts, and the boot abort message stays a live reading. |
| 15 | external-schema-drift-gate · n5 | #25815 | Applied. The no-op case asserts that the call returns undefined, not that no warn or error is logged. |
| 16 | external-schema-introspection · a3 | #25815 | Applied. The twin test twins `listRemoteTables` only. The draft twin and the shared 400 across spellings are now live readings. |
| 17 | external-schema-introspection · a4 | #25815 | Applied. The admission cases compare status and code. The 403 message naming `manage_platform_settings` is now read live. |
| 18 | external-schema-introspection · n0/n2 | #25815 | Applied. `admin-routes.test.ts` is named as a real HonoHttpServer over `vi.fn` services, route-level and not a booted stack. |
| 19 | inbound-mailbox-association · a2 | #25815 | Applied. The verify names the HTTP read the api oracle needs, and the engine-layer pin is named as evidence. |
| 20 | inbound-mailbox-association · a1 | #25815 | Applied. `inline-forward.test.ts` pins the parser only. `mail-ingest-service.test.ts` pins the inline-forward association on a real engine and is added to the ref. |
| 21 | notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility · a1 | #25815 | Applied. The integration test proves `organization_id` at the engine and nothing about the log line. The line's source text is gone on main, so only a live grep reads it. |
| 22 | notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility · a2 | #25815 | Applied. The foreign mark-read is named as unit-level evidence only. |
| 23 | notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility · a3 | #25815 | Applied. The redeliver pin is named as Request to Response on a LiteKernel, not a served stack. |
| 24 | connector-degraded-recovery · steps[4] | #25817 | Applied. `assertSameOriginOrFree` prints `Connector … replaced` on every same-name re-registration, a husk re-registered by a failed retry included. The descriptor state is the recovery signal. |
| 25 | connector-degraded-recovery · `carrier_pigeon` | #25817 | Applied to fixtures.requires[1]. `providerConfig` is deliberately untyped in the spec, so `os compile` accepts the twin and the provider factory refuses it at boot. |
| 26 | notify-inbox-delivery · knownGaps[2] | #25817 | Applied. The app-todo scratch needs a `node_modules`, and a symlink to the tree's copy works. |

Lines 5 and 8 found nothing to change; line 14's premise held only in part. None of the 26 turned out to be a product defect.

**Retired pin wording (#26035 left it to this card).** `external-schema-browser-ui` acceptance[6] and its `automated.ref` told the runner to run the objectui test "at the .objectui-sha revision". There is no `.objectui-sha` on main. The pinned test now lives at `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/external/api.test.ts`, with its 503 cases present, and runs with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` on the run subject sha. The item got its own revision and history row. Dated readings at earlier objectui pins (steps[1], acceptance[0]) are records of what was measured then and are unchanged. No `objectui:build` or `objectui:refresh` spelling exists in this file.

## Gates

Run on head `a8494b8d2`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: exit 0, `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 13 families, and all 13 ran with exit 0: `check-ci-filter-parity`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and its `--self-test`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` (after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock), `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe` and `check:watch-hint-literal`.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 13 derived, 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- No package is touched, so there is no build closure and no package test to run. Everything else is left to CI's checks on this PR.

`skip-changeset`: the diff is one file under `docs/qa/`, which no package's `files[]` ships.

## Acceptance notes

- **History `ref`.** The 13 new history rows carry `"ref": "#25844"`, the card. Earlier rows in this file name their landing PR. The PR number did not exist when the rows were written. If the seat prefers this PR's number, it is a one-line `sed` in a follow-up commit.
- **Observed, not filed:** the `Connector … replaced` warn fires on each failed retry of a degraded husk, so it repeats while an upstream stays down. Log noise, not a defect. Carrier: none.
- **Observed, not filed:** `os compile` accepting an unknown MCP `transport.kind` follows ADR-0023's untyped `providerConfig`. The boot refuses it loudly, so it is not a silent-drop trap. Carrier: none.
- **Observed, not filed:** notification-org acceptance[1] asks for the absence of a log line whose source text is deleted on main, so the check can only catch a regression that re-adds it. Carrier: none.
- **Not re-read:** `external-schema-browser-ui` steps[1] and acceptance[0] cite objectui files at the 18.0 sweep pins. They were not re-measured at `ui/` here, because they are not among the 26 lines and are not retired-script wording. Carrier: the next sweep that runs this item.
- Unpinned clauses named in the refs (the oauth2 refusal, the descriptor audit's reload path, the introspection draft twin, email-template acceptance[1], [2], [4], [6] and [7]) are coverage gaps recorded in the ledger. They are not cards.
